title: Rust: For Loops and Ranges
description: Use for loops with ranges and iterators in Rust.

steps.title: Basic For Loop
steps.description: Use a for loop with a range `1..=5` to print each number.

verification.failureMessage: Print numbers 1 through 5 using a for loop.

steps.title: For with Exclusive Range
steps.description: Use `0..10` (exclusive range) to print all even numbers from 0 to 8.
hints: Use `if i % 2 == 0` to filter even numbers.

verification.failureMessage: Print the even numbers from 0 to 8.

steps.title: Iterate Over Array
steps.description: Create an array `let fruits = ["apple", "banana", "cherry"];` and use a for loop to print each fruit.
hints: `for fruit in &fruits` also works (iterates by reference).
Arrays have a fixed size in Rust.

verification.failureMessage: Print each fruit in the array using a for loop.

steps.title: For with Enumerate
steps.description: Iterate over `["a", "b", "c"]` with `.iter().enumerate()` to print the index and value of each element.

verification.failureMessage: Print index and value for each element.

steps.title: Step By
steps.description: Use `.step_by(3)` to print every third number from 0 to 20.

verification.failureMessage: Print every third number from 0 to 20.
